text.description_html:
Brass Accents A04-P5841-RV5-605, Decorative Polished Brass Gothic Church Pull Plate with 6-1/2 Inch Handle

This polished brass gothic pull plate from the Brass Accents Renaissance Collection is made from highly detailed solid cast brass. Created in the Sargent & Company Belfort pattern, circa 1894, a Gothic church design popular at the turn of the 20th century.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance, hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of decorative hot-forged and cast brass door hardware.

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation. Hand polished and finished in the USA with a 10 year warranty.

Also available matching Decorative Gothic Church Push Plate and Gothic Church Solid Brass Pull Plate with 8" Handle

Specifications for Brass Accents Polished Brass Gothic Pull Plate:

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Plate Width: 3-3/8"
  • Plate Height: 18"
  • Pull Handle Length: 6-1/2"
  • Total Projection: 2"
  • Material: Cast Brass
  • Finish Warranty: 10 Years

Sold Individually
